newsitem.title: FINLAND: CULTOR UNIT SAYS PLANS TO CLOSE PLANT.
newsitem.headline: CULTOR UNIT SAYS PLANS TO CLOSE PLANT.

text.p: Finnish food and bakery group Cultor Oy's Sucros unit aims to ensure the competitiveness of its beet sugar production, and part of the plan is to close the Turenki factory after 1998, Sucros said on Monday.
It said it had started talks with staff about the plans.

"The aim of the negotiation process is to ensure the competitiveness of production in a changed business environment," Sucros said in a statement. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
